# GEO report: acme-mugs **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 24–33/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 21 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 5.5 ÷ 23 × 100 = 24. High = (5.5 + 2) ÷ 23 × 100 = 33. Your `robots.txt` tells every crawler to stay out of the whole site. The pages are also built in the browser, so crawlers get an empty page. The one unknown is the canonical (the page's preferred address), because no domain is declared in the code. All results are read from code. I did not check a running site. ## Live check **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop blocking all crawlers in robots.txt - **Why it matters:** `Disallow: /` asks every search engine and AI search crawler not to read any page, so nothing else you fix will be seen. This one change fixes both GEO-009 and GEO-014. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:2` - **What the code says:** `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 50–59/100 (earned 11.5) ### 2. Put the page content in the HTML the server sends - **Why it matters:** The served page is an empty `
`. The text only appears after JavaScript runs, and the catalogue list also needs an API call in the browser. Crawlers that don't run JavaScript see nothing. Prerendering or server rendering would fix this. - **Where:** `index.html:8` (also `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:6`) - **What the code says:** `
` - **Size:** Large - **Score after this:** 37–46/100 if done alone (earned 8.5) ### 3. Give pages a real title, description and language - **Why it matters:** Every page shares the title "Vite App". There is no description and no `lang` on ``, so search results and AI tools can't tell what the pages are. Setting a title and description for each route (for example with a head helper) fixes it. - **Where:** `index.html:5` - **What the code says:** `Vite App` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 33–41/100 if done alone (earned 7.5) ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid | Clear | `public/robots.txt`, 2 valid lines | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers allowed | Problem | `public/robots.txt:2` `Disallow: /` for `*` (blocker). I assumed you want to be found. | | GEO-014 | Routes indexable | Problem | Same rule blocks Googlebot and Bingbot on 2 of 2 routes. No noindex found. | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical | Can't tell | No canonical and no declared domain. Which domain do you use? | | GEO-003 | Content in server HTML | Problem | `index.html:8`, client-only React | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD valid | Not applicable | None found | | GEO-011 | Sitemap discoverable | Problem | No sitemap file or generator, and no `Sitemap:` line | | GEO-012 | Title, description, lang | Problem | `index.html:2,5`, 2 of 2 routes affected | | GEO-016 | Server-rendered links | Problem | `src/main.jsx:11` `
